digest.component_or_area: bridge operator surface / tracker sync interface
propositions: Bridge redesign unifies fragmented Jira-specific operator surface into one provider-neutral, Python-first command surface while retaining all live legacy contracts

Canonical verbs (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume) replace historical vocabulary; argument-less reconcile remains non-mutating while argument-less bridge sync is canonical mutating command
Canonical exit codes are 0, 1, and 2; legacy adapters retain historical 3, 4, and 75 translations for backward compatibility
Python core owns tickets-branch delivery including CAS retry and push budget; no workflow-local CAS loops remain
Bridge functionality is accessible through three shared interfaces: Python library, CLI (rebar bridge), and MCP server; all routes use identical core implementation
Pause state is remote-persisted, includes reason, and remains readable by mixed-version fleets; core operations have no required GitHub CLI dependency
